text: What are 4 things you should never forgive your woman for in a relationship? Let's go. Number one, cheating. Yeah, sounds obvious, but too many guys still forgive it. Look, if she cheats and you stay, you're basically saying, I have no self-respect and you can walk all over me. And trust me, if you do not respect yourself, she will not either. Number two, flirting with other guys behind your back. Texting, sending pictures, little emojis, whatever. That's emotional cheating. It's not harmless. If she's doing that, it's a red flag, man. Do not ignore it. Number three, comparing you to other men, especially her ex. If she keeps saying things like, why can't you be more like him? What she's really saying, you are not enough for me. You shouldn't stay where you are not appreciated. Number four, lying to you. And I don't mean small things like she's saying she's ready in 10 minutes, but it takes her 15 minutes. I mean big lies. She says she's out with her girlfriend to have a coffee and it turns out she's at some party with random dudes. Nah, man. Once the trust is gone, it's over. That's it. If you respect yourself, you do not tolerate this. You walk away.
